summary: WAYLOAM v0.2.4.alpha focuses on everyday polish: direct installer handoff, smoother motion, cleaner settings, a clearer home screen, a refined route mark and a more useful bike loadout illustration.
highlights: Downloaded updates now hand directly to Android's package installer instead of sending you to the Downloads folder.
Settings uses a cleaner single-surface Appearance group for theme, device colors and reduced motion.
Screen and component motion is calmer and smoother, with the odd Settings exit movement removed.
The Gear bike illustration is redrawn as a more detailed bikepacking loadout.
added: Android install-source handoff for signed alpha APK updates.
A detailed frame bag, saddle bag, handlebar bag, crank, fork and wheel treatment in the Gear bike illustration.
changed: The in-app WAYLOAM destination dot is smaller so the W-shaped route reads more clearly.
Home now leads with today's actual stage instead of generic landing-page copy.
Planner sliders use softer secondary-container track colors.
Navigation, buttons, cards and selection states use non-bouncy low-stiffness motion.
Settings keeps stable bottom layout geometry while opening and closing to prevent vertical jumps.
fixed: Removed the manual Open Downloads step from the updater.
Removed nested card-inside-card styling from Use device colors and Reduce motion settings.
Fixed the strange Settings exit transition that made the page appear to move vertically.
